summary: The study demonstrates the epitaxial growth of Mg xCa1−xO on GaN using atomic layer deposition (ALD). The material is used as a gate dielectric in GaN MOS-HEMT devices, showing high performance with an ultrahigh on/off ratio and a near-ideal subthreshold swing. The optimal composition Mg0.25Ca0.75O was found to have the lowest interfacial defect density.
evidence: ALD of Mg xCa1−xO was carried out in a home-built tubular reactor. Bis(N,N′-diisopropylacetamidinato)calcium(II) dimer, bis(N,N′-di-sec-butylacetamidinato)magnesium, and H2O were used as calcium, magnesium, and oxygen sources, respectively. The optimal growth temperature is determined to be 310 °C. The Mg0.25Ca0.75O film showed the lowest interfacial defect density.
